$comment: The photo library (docs/runbooks/photos.md): one entry per slot that has a photo, keyed by the slot (make photos-slots lists them all). Only real photos picked by a person (Pexels, Unsplash, Openverse or Open Images, under the licences core.mjs SITES lists) — never generated or invented. Fill file, alt (en, fr), focal, site, photographer, sourceUrl, licence and downloaded; make photos adds width, height, hash and placeholder. The credits page (/credits) is built from this file.
